data.why: The repo ships a small pickled NPLinker result object (GCFs, molecular families, and scored links) used by its own test suite; this is exactly the object shape the upload callback expects, and a no-links variant exercises the 'scoring table disabled' path mentioned in the README.

goals: Load a precomputed NPLinker genome-metabolome link result and get oriented on how many gene cluster families (GCFs) and molecular families (MFs) were linked
Filter the Candidate Links tables by GCF ID, BGC class, or score threshold to prioritize gene clusters worth following up experimentally
Identify high-confidence links (e.g. Average Score above a cutoff) between a biosynthetic gene cluster family and a metabolomics molecular family
Cross-reference BGC classes and MiBIG IDs against spectrum/molecular-family metadata to form hypotheses about a cluster's natural product class
Confirm that data with no computed links still loads and correctly disables the scoring table instead of erroring

review.summary: The tree follows the webapp's real flow (load a result, look at GCFs/MFs, filter and select, then filter, sort, annotate and export the Candidate Links), and every screen I opened shows what its node claims. It needs fixes before filing: it calls the Scoring panel a score computation or threshold when it only selects precomputed links by their stored parameters, it makes a QA check a phase, and it leaves out the per-row link-detail tooltip and the explicit choice of link direction.
